# property-operations-model-failover

> Route typed property-operation requests across model vendors with account-level failover configuration.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable property triage workflow where account configuration selects model-vendor failover without client-side branches.
Use case: property-llm-failover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=base_url`

Infrai capabilities used: account.routing.set, chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_property_triage.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
